name: 'Linux'

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'master'
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, synchronize ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency: 
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  Build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        # `OfflineTools` builds AssetPacker and ShaderCompiler as well. Neither of them ends up in the game
        # package and neither depends on the backend or the RHI, so it's enough to compile them once per
        # compiler (this entry and the clang one below) instead of in all six configurations. AssetPacker is
        # published as its own artifact, but only from this entry - see the packaging step below.
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: GLFW
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
          OfflineTools: 'ON'

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: GLFW
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++
          OfflineTools: 'ON'
          
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++

        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL2
          RHI: Vulkan
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++

        # SDL3 backend (testing only for now). libsdl3-dev isn't in the ubuntu-22.04 repos, so this entry runs
        # on ubuntu-26.04 where it can be installed via apt (see the SDL3 dependency step below).
        - BuildType: Release
          Platform: x64
          Backend: SDL3
          RHI: OpenGL
          CC: gcc
          CXX: g++
          OS: ubuntu-26.04

    #runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.OS || 'ubuntu-22.04' }}

    steps:
    - name: 'Checkout Repository'
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: 'Create Build Environment'
      run: |
        sudo apt update -y
        # `libdw-dev` (elfutils) is what makes the crash reports readable: without it Backward falls back to
        # `backtrace_symbols()`, which resolves addresses through the dynamic symbol table only - and since
        # everything is compiled with `-fvisibility=hidden`, that yields bare addresses and no function names.
        # It's also the only stack details backend that follows ".gnu_debuglink" into the split symbol file.
        sudo apt install -y cmake curl g++ libgl1-mesa-dev libopenmpt-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libdw-dev rpm

    - if: matrix.CC == 'clang'
      name: 'Configure Clang Compiler'
      uses: egor-tensin/setup-clang@v1
      with:
        version: 15

    - if: matrix.Backend == 'SDL3'
      name: 'Install SDL3'
      run: |
        # libsdl3-dev is available from the ubuntu-24.04 repositories (this entry runs on ubuntu-24.04).
        # libmpg123-dev is added so the linker can satisfy libopenmpt's transitive libmpg123 dependency.
        sudo apt install -y libsdl3-dev libmpg123-dev

      run: |
        export CC=${{ matrix.CC }}
        export CXX=${{ matrix.CXX }}

        rm -f ./Content/Translations/*.po
